name: address
description: Represents an address that represents person or another entity that reads or writes messages.

properties.name: address
properties.description: A string representation of this address

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this address was added to the database

name: address name
description: Links a human-readable name to an email address

properties.name: address id
properties.description: Id of the address to which this name corresponds

properties.name: name
properties.description: Human-readable name of this entity, if available

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this link was first documented

properties.name: is self assigned
properties.description: Whether this name is used by this person themselves

name: attachment
description: Represents an attached file within a message

properties.name: message id
properties.description: Id of the message to which this file is attached

properties.name: file name
properties.description: Name of the attached file, as appears on the file system

name: message
description: Represents a message sent between two or more individuals or entities

properties.name: thread id
properties.description: Id of the thread to which this message belongs

properties.name: sender id
properties.description: Id of the address from which this message was sent

properties.name: message id
properties.description: (Unique) id given to this message by the sender

properties.name: reply to id
properties.description: Id of the message this message replies to, if applicable

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this message was sent

name: message recipient link
description: Links a message to it's assigned recipients

properties.name: message id
properties.description: Id of the sent message

properties.name: recipient id
properties.description: Id of the message recipient (address)

properties.name: role
properties.description: Role / type of the message recipient

name: message statement link
description: Documents a statement made within a message

properties.name: message id
properties.description: Id of the message where the statement was made

properties.name: statement id
properties.description: Id of the placed statement

properties.name: order index
properties.description: 0-based index that indicates the specific location of the placed text

name: message thread
description: Represents a subject or a header given to a sequence of messages

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this thread was opened

name: message thread subject link
description: Connects a subject with a message thread in which it was used

properties.name: thread id
properties.description: Id of the thread where the referenced subject was used

properties.name: subject id
properties.description: Id of the subject used in the specified thread

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this subject was first used in the specified thread

name: pending reply reference
description: Documents an unresolved reference made from a reply message

properties.name: message id
properties.description: Id of the message from which this reference is made from

properties.name: referenced message id
properties.description: Message id of the referenced message

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this pending reply reference was added to the database

name: pending thread reference
description: Used for documenting those message ids involved within threads, that have not been linked to any read message

properties.name: thread id
properties.description: Id of the message thread with which the referenced message is linked to

properties.name: referenced message id
properties.description: Message id belonging to some unread message in the linked thread

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this pending thread reference was added to the database

name: subject
description: Represents a named subject on a message (thread)

properties.name: created
properties.description: Time when this subject was first used

name: subject statement link
description: Connects a message thread subject to the statements made within that subject

properties.name: subject id
properties.description: Id of the described subject

properties.name: statement id
properties.description: Id of the placed statement

properties.name: order index
properties.description: 0-based index that indicates the specific location of the placed text

name: statement placement
description: Places a statement within some text

properties.name: parent id
properties.description: Id of the text where the placed text appears

properties.name: statement id
properties.description: Id of the placed statement

properties.name: order index
properties.description: 0-based index that indicates the specific location of the placed text

name: text placement
description: Places some type of text to some location within another text

properties.name: parent id
properties.description: Id of the text where the placed text appears

properties.name: placed id
properties.description: Id of the text that is placed within the parent text

properties.name: order index
properties.description: 0-based index that indicates the specific location of the placed text
